objective: Provide a provider-neutral acceptance protocol that prevents visibly weak generated video from being promoted as high-quality output without structured review.

sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.name: Prompt and storyboard adherence
sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.review: Confirm requested subject, action, environment, shot intent, duration and continuity are materially present without major invented scene changes.

sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.name: Temporal and motion coherence
sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.review: Check frame-to-frame stability, natural motion, object permanence, camera continuity and absence of abrupt morphology changes or unexplained motion jumps.

sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.name: Character, face and reference consistency
sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.review: Check identity, clothing, proportions, product details and other reference-bound features remain stable across shots where consistency is required.

sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.name: Visual fidelity and artifact control
sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.review: Check anatomy, hands, eyes, edges, textures, duplicated objects, warping, flicker, ghosting, compression-like artifacts and unreadable generated text.

sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.name: Composition and camera quality
sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.review: Check framing, shot size, camera movement, horizon, focus, lighting continuity and whether the camera behavior supports the requested scene rather than distracting from it.

sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.name: Audio, speech and lip synchronization
sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.review: When audio exists, check intelligibility, clipping, timing, background balance, dialogue continuity and visible mouth-to-speech alignment where applicable.

sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.name: Captions, overlays and readable text
sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.review: Check captions and overlays are readable, correctly timed, safe inside the target frame and free from obvious spelling or character corruption.

sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.name: Delivery integrity
sakthiaiAcceptanceDimensions.review: Check expected aspect ratio, duration, complete beginning/end, absence of unintended black frames or frozen tails, and suitability for the target publishing surface.

scoring.note: Thresholds below are SakthiAI internal engineering gates, not claims sourced from an external benchmark.

criticalDefects: identity changes that materially alter the intended person or principal character
severe anatomy or object deformation dominating a shot
gross lip-sync failure when synchronized speech is a core requirement
unreadable or materially wrong required on-screen text
output substantially contradicts the approved prompt/storyboard
reviewProtocol: Review the complete video once at normal playback speed without pausing.
Review a second time shot-by-shot for temporal, identity, anatomy, camera and text defects.
Review audio separately with headphones when speech, music or synchronization matters.
Record dimension scores and every critical defect; do not hide defects behind a single average score.
Reject a candidate immediately when any critical defect is present.
If two candidate renders exist, compare them against the same rubric and keep the better evidence-backed result rather than selecting by provider reputation.
Do not claim Tamil speech, pronunciation, captions or cultural quality without SakthiAI Tamil-specific human evaluation.
